title: hedeoma scutellarioides
intro: Hedeoma scutellarioides, commonly known as American pennyroyal or Prickly Tea Mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including aiding in digestion, reducing anxiety and stress, and possessing antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hedeoma scutellarioides include antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic activities, making it useful for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
